freshPixelPoseCommonFrameMetrics.exclusionReason: Two baseline selected photos did not produce a fresh face; candidate had fresh detections on all 134 unique selected photos and all 410 face frames. Means here use the same 408 frames on both sides.

selectedIdChangeInterpretation: All 410 ID strings changed under the new clean-v5 encoded-image namespace; this count alone does not imply 410 different photo pixels.

limitations: Browser baseline is the frozen 7b application/old catalog; full-pose census baseline is the different fixed c92 admitted candidate.
Both baseline and candidate initial presentation passed in this actual run. The known baseline initial-failure exception was not used; prior runs are not substituted for this result.
Fresh pose comparison excludes the same two undetected baseline frames on both sides; stored descriptor metrics use all 410 common input frames.
This fixed video exercises 16 left-wink input frames and no right-wink input frames. Both returned 16 correct left sides; right-wink behavior is not established by this clip.
The virtual camera is an 8-second software fixture on native CI. Telemetry is a bounded automated observation, not a physical camera, user-device, or deployed Site measurement.
The historical independent 360-photo holdout remains failed. Separate exact original-image review and its native-index binding are not performed or changed by this aggregation.
